verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question for an agent-building SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents issuing, scoping, or restricting API credentials per agent. Tool-approval interruptions, guardrails, and sandbox workspaces are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
